exposure: Women with low-lying placenta and marginal sinus
Planned mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean)
cohort: Women with low-lying placenta delivered at a hospital between April 2012 and December 2015
finding: Trial of labor in women with low-lying placenta is a viable option except for those with marginal sinus, as it resulted in lower intrapartum blood loss without significant differences in neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Trial of labor can be offered to all the women with low-lying placenta except for those accompanied by marginal sinus.
